name: M1 Long — Confluence Model

The bullish counterpart to M1 Short — same window, opposite setup logic (fade gap-down vs continuation on gap-down panic).

Pre-market confluences (check by 9:25): no pre-RTH news scheduled (+21.1pp), prior day closed in middle 1/3 (33-67%, +9.5pp), VIXY in normal regime (+6.6pp), IS FOMC week (+6.3pp), day=Wednesday (+6.3pp), gap < -100 pts (gap_large_down, +5.5pp). frequency: ~14/yr (~1.2/mo) — roughly 1 every 25 days. From 8yr backtest, 117 trades.
